title: The Cold Anvil
text: An anvil that has not been struck in an age, rimed with frost in a room where the coals still glow. Beside it stands a smith's ghost, leather apron and all. It mends whatever arm strikes it, the ghost says, if the arm is honest about the blow.

options.label: The one with the hurt arm strikes the anvil, and is honest about the blow.

outcomes.text: The ring of it runs up the bone like cold fire. The arm is whole again; the ghost nods.
The anvil rings and the arm goes numb. Something in the blow was not honest, so a little of the numbness stays.

options.label: The strongest works the anvil for the ghost, so that it may see one more blade made.

outcomes.text: They forge a blade the ghost is proud of. It nods once, then fades into the frost.

options.label: Take the anvil for the House. A ghost cannot carry it, after all.

outcomes.text: The anvil is heavy as sin. The ghost follows it, standing behind whoever carries it, watching.
